shadows.name: heart-ground
shadows.value: RibbonShadow at 14% light / 28% dark; 14pt blur; y-offset 0.33 × field height
shadows.purpose: Grounds the mesh without elevating surrounding data or controls.

motion.name: heart-clock
motion.value: Up to 30 updates/second; phase advances BPM/60 cycles per second
motion.purpose: Continuous-phase nonuniform squash/rebound visualizes rate, not detected beat timing.

motion.name: heart-freeze
motion.value: Stop autonomous motion when paused, stale, missing BPM, Reduce Motion, private, offscreen, or inactive
motion.purpose: Never imply current pulse through decorative autonomous motion.

motion.name: heart-drag
motion.value: Bounded yaw/pitch geometry rotation; disabled for Reduce Motion
motion.purpose: Reveals real volume without changing pulse data.

assets.name: App Icon
assets.description: Interwoven plum, lavender, and pink ribbons on a pale lavender ground, without text.

nativeHeart.geometry: PulseHeartMesh; closed front/back mesh with smooth normals
nativeHeart.material: SceneKit physicallyBased; roughness 0.22; metalness 0.08; opaque adaptive PulseHeart diffuse
nativeHeart.lighting: White key180, pink rim130, lavender fill35, ambient55
nativeHeart.rendering: 4x antialiasing; on-demand SCNView; main-thread updates; no renderer delegate
nativeHeart.fullscreen: Shared PulseStore and pause binding; 44pt close/pause; portrait stack and landscape split; scrollable at accessibility sizes
nativeHeart.demoStatus: Demo · Sample data / Sample signal; never an ECG claim

components.name: Primary Watch Action
components.description: The full-width 52pt capsule that opens watch selection.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { width: 100%; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #4B2459; color: #F7E8F8; font: 600 17px system-ui; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-primary-action:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-primary-action:active { transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6D0B73; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Motion Control
components.description: A 44pt pause/play control shared by the dashboard and fullscreen heart; readings continue while paused.
components.html: <button class="ds-motion-control" aria-label="Pause heart animation"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M7 5h4v14H7zm6 0h4v14h-4z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-motion-control { width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #ECDAF5; color: #27082A; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-motion-control svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-motion-control:hover { filter: brightness(0.97); } .ds-motion-control:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-motion-control:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6D0B73; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Current Pulse Reading
components.description: The dominant monospaced pulse value with a smaller baseline unit.
components.css: .ds-pulse-reading { color: #27082A; display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; font-family: system-ui; } .ds-pulse-reading strong { font-size: 88px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-pulse-reading span { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Demo Disclosure
components.description: The explicit label that separates synthetic sample data from a live sensor.

components.name: Recent Range
components.description: Two recent extrema separated by one quiet vertical divider.
components.css: .ds-range { color: #27082A; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 24px; font-family: system-ui; } .ds-range div { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; } .ds-range strong { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-range span { color: #5D3F67; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-range i { width: 1px; height: 40px; background: #B59ABE; }

components.name: Sensor Row
components.description: A native list-style sensor choice with a watch symbol and 44pt minimum target.
components.css: .ds-sensor-row { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 6px 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #4B2459; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font: 400 17px system-ui; text-align: left; } .ds-sensor-row svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-sensor-row:hover { color: #6D0B73; } .ds-sensor-row:active { opacity: 0.72; } .ds-sensor-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6D0B73; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
“Kinetic Pulse Instrument” is descriptive shorthand for the implemented visual system, not a user quotation. The interface treats pulse as one measured subject: a glossy, real 3D cartoon heart occupies the expressive field, while a large numeric reading and one-minute trend keep the data legible and honest.

The system is native, spacious, and focused rather than diagnostic. Pale lavender and plum establish the light appearance; asset-catalog counterparts preserve the same hierarchy in Dark Mode. Motion remains subordinate to fresh data and stops for stale data, pause, Reduce Motion, and privacy-safe presentation.
keyCharacteristics: One kinetic sculpture, one current reading, and one recent trend.
Adaptive plum, lavender, and pink assets with native SwiftUI controls.
Compact portrait stacking and a separate iPad landscape split.
Explicit demo, waiting, stale, missing-data, and privacy-safe states.

rules.name: The Adaptive Palette Rule
rules.body: Use the named asset colors rather than hard-coded view colors so light and dark appearances change together.

rules.name: The Reading First Rule
rules.body: Reserve the display scale for the current pulse value; all explanations remain in Dynamic Type styles.

rules.name: The Sculpture Owns Depth Rule
rules.body: Keep surrounding controls and data surfaces visually flat so the kinetic field remains the only dimensional object.

rules.name: The Honest Motion Rule
rules.body: Animate only from a fresh visible pulse; never use the sculpture to imply ECG timing or a current value when the signal is stale.

dos: Do keep the sculpture, current reading, trend, range, and primary watch action in one clear hierarchy.
Do use named adaptive color assets, Dynamic Type, SF Symbols, 44pt controls, and native sheets.
Do preserve missing-data gaps and label synthetic demo data explicitly.
Do freeze motion for pause, stale data, Reduce Motion, and privacy-safe presentation.
donts: Don't turn the surface into a diagnostic dashboard, card grid, or notification-control panel.
Don't draw ECG spikes or describe the sculpture as exact heartbeat timing.
Don't display a stale or privacy-redacted BPM as current.
Don't add decorative depth outside the heart sculpture.
